title: Lights toggling
statementMd:
`n` lights start off. In round `i` (1..n) toggle every `i`-th light. Return how many lights are on at the end.

**Example:** `toggle_lights(3)` returns `1`.
hints: Only perfect squares have an odd number of divisors.
solutionMd:
```python
def toggle_lights(n):
    count = 0
    k = 1
    while k * k <= n:
        count += 1
        k += 1
    return count
```

Lights at perfect-square positions end on.
